finding: ClayGraph must represent self.root/person/client/API separation, goal/interest/project relations, web-evidence ancestry/taint, visual and GWT links, and salience separately from truth/effect authority. Proactive AgencyState adds new dynamic topology consumers but no authority amplification.
counterhypotheses: Agency-driven graph fanout may reduce precision and increase stale association risk.
Some goal/interest relations may be better represented in bounded compiled assemblies than persistent graph topology.
required_validation: Query/goal-conditioned fanout, stale/conflict/revoked lesions, poisoned-edge tests and downstream outcome comparisons against non-graph baselines.
ancestry_policy: One coordinated target architecture lineage; not replication.
